description: Watch for changes to Events resources. Watch channels expire; persist the channel `id` per `calendarId` to re-establish watches after expiration or restarts.

address.description: The address where notifications are delivered for this channel. Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL; http:// or localhost URLs will not receive notifications.
address.human_parameter_description: The URL where we should send change notifications. Provide a publicly accessible HTTPS endpoint that you control.
address.title: Address

calendarId.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendarId.human_parameter_description: Which calendar you want to watch for changes. Use 'primary' for your own calendar, or enter a specific calendar ID.
calendarId.title: Calendar Id

id.description: A UUID or similar unique string that identifies this channel.
id.human_parameter_description: A unique identifier for this watch channel so you can track or stop it later. Use a UUID or any unique string you control.
id.title: Id

params.description: Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior. Optional.
params.human_parameter_description: Extra settings that control how notifications are sent (for example, how long the channel should stay active). You can leave this empty unless you need custom behavior.

ttl.description: Time To Live for the notification channel.
ttl.title: Ttl

params.title: EventsWatchRequestParams

payload.description: A Boolean value to indicate whether payload is wanted. Optional.
payload.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to include event details in each notification. Turn this on if your endpoint needs the full event data.
payload.title: Payload

token.description: An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel. Optional.
token.human_parameter_description: Any secret or identifier you want echoed back with each notification, so your endpoint can verify the source. Optional.
token.title: Token

type.description: The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel.
type.human_parameter_description: How notifications will be delivered. Use 'web_hook' to receive HTTP callbacks at the address you provide.
type.title: Type

name: events_watch

display_url.description: URL to view this resource in Google Calendar web UI. None for notification channels as they have no direct web UI.
display_url.title: Display Url

expiration.description: The actual expiration time for this channel, expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds and represented as a string. Present only if applicable (i.e., if the channel has an expiration).
expiration.title: Expiration

id.description: A unique string that identifies this channel. Client-defined unique identifier used to distinguish notifications; typically the ID you specified when creating the channel.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Identifies this as a notification channel resource. Always "api#channel".
kind.title: Kind

resourceId.description: An opaque identifier for the resource being watched on this channel, assigned by Google; stable across different API versions and used (along with id) to stop the channel and validate notifications.
resourceId.title: Resource Id

resourceUri.description: The canonical URI of the watched resource (e.g., the calendar's events feed) in the context of the current API version.
resourceUri.title: Resource Uri

token.description: Optional arbitrary verification token supplied by the client; delivered to the target address with each notification for this channel and echoed back to help verify notification source. Present only if you provided a token when creating the channel.
token.title: Token
